moments.text: Infrared view of hazy grey sky with a box and crosshair at centre and black redaction bars. At 0.55 s it zooms in on a bright white spot held in the box.
The sensor alternates between wide and close views of the spot at centre; around 6.8 s it flips from bright to dark with a bright rim.
A white flash, then a darker textured background with the object as a dark spot in the box; at 12.7 s it turns bright again.
After three tilted frames, a smooth hazy grey view, darker toward the lower corners; the object is a tiny dot inside a small box at centre.
A bright frame, then a grainy view; the box stays at centre but the object no longer stands out.
The box wanders up-left, then down toward the lower right and back up, with nothing distinct inside it.
